user_saw: WhatsApp users could hit a delivery error in DMs, while Mattermost users could see a turn stall without receiving the question.
summary: The fix limits the built-in ask_user tool to inbound surfaces with native question support and lets agents ask in ordinary text elsewhere.
reasoning: The original ask_user registration checked session eligibility and tool policy and explicitly relied on a plain-text fallback across channels. I checked the later commits that added WhatsApp reaction handling and Mattermost buttons, but the local evidence does not establish whether the reported delivery failures existed at launch or began with a later code change.
